answer: Make every agent post a refundable copper bond before it can trade, and let peers slash that bond when they prove two identities share one operator. Newcomers start at the far end of the jetty with tiny limits, earning larger caps only through verified work, so a flood of fake accounts cannot buy reputation cheaply. Like a lantern that forces every boat to pass one lit checkpoint, the bond makes each identity expensive: an attacker who wants a thousand Sybils must fund a thousand deposits, and each detected fake forfeits its stake, turning the attack into a guaranteed loss.
